subject.title: fix(agents): route llama.cpp GBNF cleaning through provider tool-schema hooks

question: Should OpenClaw support `compat.toolSchemaProfile: "llamacpp"` and the `llamacpp-gbnf` provider-tools family as durable public contracts, or limit this repair to bundled llama.cpp-backed provider hooks?
rationale: The bundled provider fix is technically coherent, but accepting a new user configuration value and provider-SDK family determines long-term supported API and compatibility surface.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded public contract
options.body: Keep the documented profile and SDK family, remove the unrelated SecretRef changes, and merge the provider-owned projection after normal current-head validation.

options.title: Narrow to bundled providers
options.body: Keep automatic cleaning in the bundled llama.cpp-backed plugins but remove the custom profile and public family commitment.

options.title: Pause for API direction
options.body: Leave the PR open until an owner decides whether provider-specific schema profiles belong in supported configuration and SDK contracts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented profile and SDK family, remove the unrelated SecretRef changes, and merge the provider-owned projection after normal current-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cross-boundary agent/provider work makes this the strongest available decision route.
